long_biography.plain_text:
Bush built his career in educational staffing, founding Source4Teachers and serving as its president as it recruited and managed substitute teachers, paraprofessionals and support staff for school districts. He led the company through rapid regional growth and a 2015 acquisition by Nautic Partners, then remained involved as it merged with Education Solutions Services and expanded nationally.

After moving to Naples, Bush redirected his operating experience into a portfolio of newer ventures. He manages Bush Family Partnerships, leads CPL Landscape Maintenance & Construction and chairs Leadline, a recruiting-software company shaped by his staffing background. Across those roles, he combines direct company building with growth-capital investment, while his best-documented business creation remains school-staffing services.
